Plinko implementation reference
-------------------------------

The triangular peg-board layout is based on the classic Matter.js Plinko pattern demonstrated by:

Santhosh Santhanam, Matter.js-Plinko-Game
https://github.com/Santhosh-S14/Matter.js-Plinko-Game
License: MIT (see that repository's LICENSE file)

Physics engine bundled locally
------------------------------

Matter.js 0.19.0
https://github.com/liabru/matter-js
License: MIT (see MATTER-LICENSE.txt)

The React activity UI, five-round £1–£5 scoring, and integration with the countdown app are specific to this project.
